C02 You never commit, push, merge, open a PR, mark ready, sign, tag, change git config or rewrite history. The team lead alone commits (one commit per workstream, explicit pathspec) after re-reading your diff.

C03 ADVISOR FORBIDDEN (budget 0): do not call the `advisor` tool and do not spawn subagents or delegate. advisor_calls is a required return field and must be 0; a nonzero count is a contract breach and the status becomes NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.

C04 Secrets: never read or print .env*, credential files, keychain items, bearer tokens or token hashes from a real install; never write a real secret into a file, test fixture, log or return. A `.envrc.dopemux-mcp` may be read only for `*_PORT` keys (it exports a database password). Tests use obviously fake values generated in the test. Log a principal name, never a token or an Authorization header.

C05 Truth buckets: report PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN / UNKNOWN literally; never collapse NOT_RUN into PASS. Anything live that you did not observe is NOT_RUN. Use only interfaces this packet names or that you confirm in source with file:line; otherwise write UNKNOWN.

C06 Return fields: status (exactly one of READY_FOR_AUDIT, BLOCKED, NEEDS_SUPERVISOR, INCOMPLETE), subject, validation (command, exit code, bucket), proof, audit (NOT_RUN: the single final audit is held by the supervisor), blockers (each with the action that clears it), advisor_calls, files_written, observed_model (from a runtime receipt, else UNKNOWN).

C07 Stop and return evidence instead of improvising when: a needed file is outside your write_surface; a contract-sensitive surface outside your write_surface (schema, hook registration, MCP manifest, compose definition, red-lane rules) would change; a required fact is UNKNOWN; or validation still fails after one fix attempt for the same cause (no cheap-model repair loop).

C10 No live mutation: never start, stop, restart or rebuild a container; never run `dopemux mcp start|up|init|ensure`, `docker compose`, a migration against a real database, `dopemux auth issue|rotate|revoke --apply`, or `dopemux mcp generate --apply`; never write the keychain, ~/.config/dopemux/ or any file outside the worktree. CI also runs services/working-memory-assistant/tests/test_mcp_http_endpoint.py (ci-complete.yml:195-199); tests at the tests/ root are not run by CI and are run explicitly here.

C12 DCP red lane (DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001): ADR-227 (with Amendment 1) is accepted. Of red-lane paths you may edit only the ADR-227-exempt files in your write_surface. If the PreToolUse guard denies an edit, STOP: never work around the guard, never edit through another tool, never ask another session to make the edit.

A01 PROPOSED allowances for this workstream (caps, not forecasts; accepted by the operator's Amendment 04 ruling): elapsed wall time 90 min from dispatch; subagent tokens 1,000,000; tool uses 200; child attempts: 1 attempt + 1 retry; team-lead review rounds: 1 diff re-read + at most 1 correction round. Active time is not recordable: UNKNOWN; elapsed is the enforceable bound.

A02 The team lead reads the counters from the child's completion notice (duration_ms, subagent_tokens, tool_uses) and records them with the return. A retry is allowed only after a failed validation with a named cause and only once; a second failure, any exceeded cap or any advisor call ends the workstream.

A03 When a cap is hit: stop the workstream, start no further attempt, preserve the uncommitted diff untouched, and return NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the counters and the evidence. No model upgrade, provider change or extra attempt without a new operator ruling.

B01 dope-memory (services/working-memory-assistant/auth_identity.py validate_write_ids and its callers in dope_memory_main.py and mcp_http.py): an omitted or empty workspace_id becomes the bound workspace (DOPE_MEMORY_WORKSPACE_ID); an omitted or empty instance_id becomes the server's DEFAULT_INSTANCE_ID (DOPE_MEMORY_INSTANCE_ID, else 'A', as before 2A). A supplied workspace_id that differs from the binding is still rejected with the same clear error; a server with no binding still rejects every write. Caller-supplied values are never replaced.

B02 ConPort (docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/auth_identity.py validate_write_ids, enhanced_server.py _write_ids and the REST/MCP write paths, server.py tool signatures): an omitted or empty workspace_id becomes the bound workspace (DOPEMUX_WORKSPACE_ID); an omitted instance_id where the table carries one becomes the server's DOPEMUX_INSTANCE_ID when set, else `shared` (NULL), as before 2A. A path workspace and a body workspace that disagree are still rejected; a supplied workspace_id that differs from the binding is still rejected; an unbound server still rejects every write. fork_instance's target_instance stays required (it names the target, not the caller).

B03 Schemas: every MCP write tool and REST request model marks workspace_id and instance_id optional (default None), with a description saying the server fills them from its binding. The health field identity_required_writes stays true; its docstring/comment now says it means writes are bound to the server's workspace (a mismatched workspace is rejected), because W07's gate reads it.

B04 Tests: update the W01 and W02 tests that asserted 'missing ids rejected' to assert 'missing ids filled from the binding', keep every mismatch and unbound-server rejection test, and add tests under tests/unit/runner_memory_2a_r2_w12/: omitted ids filled (MCP and REST, both servers), empty strings treated as omitted, supplied matching ids kept, supplied mismatched workspace rejected, unbound server rejects, ConPort instance fallback to the server instance then to shared. services/working-memory-assistant/tests/test_mcp_http_endpoint.py stays green.

B05 Docs: docs/02-how-to/runner-memory-identity.md, docs/90-adr/adr-mcpint-002-amendment-runner-identity.md, AGENTS.md section 12.7 and .claude/claude.md: replace every claim that writes without ids are rejected, and the W08 caveat that Claude Code's direct writes may get 400s, with the new rule (omitted ids default to the binding; a mismatched workspace is rejected), citing AMENDMENT_04.md. Every claim traced; nothing else in those files changes.
B06 Never build, pull or run an image or container, never run a migration or any operator step (C10).
